rules.title: Border Router Redundancy
rules.description: Assesses whether authoritative current evidence contains enough Border Routers for failover.
rules.action: Add or restore Border Routers if resilience is required.
rules.verify: Process a complete Border-Router-bearing observation.

rules.title: Router Redundancy
rules.description: Assesses whether current topology evidence contains enough routing devices for redundancy.
rules.action: Add or restore Router-capable devices if resilience is required.
rules.verify: Process a complete topology observation and compare the Router count.

rules.title: Border Router OMR Addressing
rules.description: Reports whether an observed Border Router has an address in the OMR prefix without claiming tested external reachability.
rules.action: Inspect Border Router backbone connectivity and OMR prefix advertisement when addressing is absent.
rules.verify: Process a complete observation and confirm a Border Router address remains in the OMR prefix.

rules.title: Router Path Redundancy
rules.description: Identifies router-neighbor bridges and articulation Routers in the currently observed routing graph.
rules.action: Inspect single points of failure and preserve alternate usable router paths.
rules.verify: Process another complete topology observation and compare bridges and articulation Routers.

rules.title: Network Link Quality Distribution
rules.description: Summarizes the distribution of observed non-missing link-quality reports.
rules.action: Inspect weak relationships and preserve strong alternate paths.
rules.verify: Process another complete topology observation and compare the distribution.

rules.title: Offline Device Network Impact
rules.description: Separately assesses whether individually Offline devices are material to network health.
rules.action: Restore Offline devices or revise the expected roster after confirming their operational role.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and confirm the Offline ratio falls below policy.

rules.title: Duplicate Relationships in Source Data
rules.description: Reports duplicate source relationships as a collection artifact.
rules.action: No action required unless duplicates recur across observations.
rules.verify: Confirm the relationship count is unaffected in the next complete observation.

rules.title: Observed Devices
rules.description: Records device presence in the current cached observation.
rules.action: No action required.
rules.verify: Process another complete cached observation to confirm continued presence.

rules.title: Expected Device Missing
rules.description: Reports an expected device absent without enough eligible history to establish Offline.
rules.action: Check collection completeness, then inspect the expected device if absence persists.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and confirm whether the device returns.

rules.title: Offline Devices
rules.description: Reports an expected device absent for the configured consecutive complete observations.
rules.action: Inspect the expected device after confirming collection completeness.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and confirm whether the device returns.

rules.title: Mesh Diagnostic Query Timed Out
rules.description: Reports attributed missing diagnostic evidence for a device.
rules.action: Investigate load, sleep behavior, or connectivity if this persists across observations.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and confirm whether the device responds.

rules.title: High Link Errors Reported by Multiple Neighbors
rules.description: Correlates elevated delivery errors reported by multiple observed relationships.
rules.action: Investigate interference or firmware for this device rather than one specific link.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and confirm whether multiple reporters still agree.

rules.title: Parent Changes Since Counter Reset
rules.description: Reports a cumulative parent-change counter that requires a later delta to establish current churn.
rules.action: Compare against a future observation before treating this as a current failure.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and compare the delta or trend.

rules.title: Partition ID Changes Since Counter Reset
rules.description: Reports a cumulative partition-change counter that requires a later delta to establish current instability.
rules.action: Compare against a future observation before treating this as a current failure.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and compare the delta or trend.

rules.title: Better-Partition Attach Attempts Since Counter Reset
rules.description: Reports cumulative attempts to attach to a better partition.
rules.action: Compare against a future observation before treating this as a current failure.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and compare the delta or trend.

rules.title: Parent and Partition Changes Since Counter Reset
rules.description: Reports a cumulative combined parent and partition change counter.
rules.action: Compare against a future observation before treating this as a current failure.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and compare the delta or trend.

rules.title: Low Router-Role Time Since Reset
rules.description: Reports low cumulative Router-role time for an observed Router or Leader.
rules.action: Compare against a future observation and the device's intended role.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and compare the delta or trend.

rules.title: Detached or Disabled Time Since Reset
rules.description: Reports cumulative detached or disabled uptime without claiming current detachment.
rules.action: Compare against a future observation before treating this as a current failure.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and compare the delta or trend.

rules.title: High Device MAC Error Ratio
rules.description: Reports a current device-wide MAC error ratio with a valid packet denominator.
rules.action: Inspect link conditions and packet counters for this device.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation with a valid packet denominator.

rules.title: High Device MAC Discard Ratio
rules.description: Reports a current device-wide MAC discard ratio with a valid packet denominator.
rules.action: Inspect link conditions and packet counters for this device.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation with a valid packet denominator.

rules.title: Device Not Attached to Mesh
rules.description: Reports a current detached, disabled, or orphaned attachment state.
rules.action: Inspect the device and its parent or commissioning state.
rules.verify: Collect and process a new complete observation after remediation.

rules.title: Strong Bidirectional Link (LQ3)
rules.description: Reports a relationship where both observed directions have LQ3.
rules.action: No action required.
rules.verify: Compare both directions in the next complete observation.

rules.title: Link Quality or Delivery Degradation

variants.delivery-errors-adequate-signal: High Delivery Errors Despite Acceptable Signal

rules.description: Reports current directional LQ, delivery, RSS, or margin degradation using relationship-specific policy and path evidence.
rules.action: Inspect both endpoints and nearby RF conditions; preserve alternate paths.
rules.verify: Collect another complete observation and compare both directions.

rules.title: Indirect Messages Queued for Child
rules.description: Reports current indirect messages queued on a parent-child relationship as trend evidence.
rules.action: Compare against a future observation before treating this as a current failure.
rules.verify: Process another complete observation and confirm the queue clears.
